skidpad_g.what: steady cornering grip at 60 km/h, full lock

turn_in.what: step steer at 60 km/h: time to 63 % of the final yaw rate

yaw_overshoot.what: step steer at 60 km/h: yaw-rate overshoot

slalom_drift.what: slalom at 100 km/h (0.6 Hz, ±0.6): biggest slide angle

liftoff_tighten.what: lift off mid-corner at 80 km/h: yaw rate after / before

liftoff_drift.what: lift off mid-corner at 80 km/h: biggest slide angle

trailbrake_drift.what: brake hard mid-corner at 80 km/h: biggest slide angle

handbrake_turn.what: handbrake turn from 60 km/h (steer + handbrake 1 s): rotation

handbrake_recover.what: flick the tail out at 70 km/h (handbrake 0.5 s), then straighten up with 60 % throttle: time until it grips again (slide < 3°; NaN = it spun out)

turning_circle.what: turning circle, kerb to kerb (outer front wheel radius)

body_roll.what: body roll in the skidpad corner

water_pullaway.what: stopped in the shallows: speed after 3 s full throttle (it must wade out, not stick)

sand_grip.what: cornering grip on sand at 40 km/h, full lock

key_corner_100_slide.what: keyboard: hold left at 100 km/h for 4 s (Assisted): biggest slide angle

key_corner_100_g.what: keyboard: hold left at 100 km/h: sideways grip used

key_corner_60_g.what: keyboard: hold left at 60 km/h: sideways grip used

aidsoff_flick.what: aids off: the handbrake flick at 70 km/h, the driver counter-steering: time to grip again (NaN = spun out)

cam_corner_lead.what: camera: steady corner at 60 km/h: how far it looks into the turn

cam_slide_follow.what: camera: in a handbrake slide, how much of the slide angle it follows

cam_lookback.what: camera: time to swing round to look behind (B)

cam_brake_close.what: camera: braking hard from 100 km/h, how much closer it comes

cam_slalom_smooth.what: camera: slalom at 100 km/h, RMS of its turning acceleration (lower = smoother)

standstill_creep.what: parked, no input, 10 s: how far it creeps

physics_cost.what: physics time per 60 fps frame (4 steps)
